notes.title: The game should be fully functioning, patch and all!
notes.content:
As promised, here are the secret names! (Some of them make the game vastly more difficult so keep that in mind!)

Luci: Automatically go to NG+
Alek: Disable Save (No emerald)
WDM2: Disable Save, Lower to 4 party members (No emerald)
Weasel: Disable Save, Lower to 3 party members (No emerald)
WhyME: Disable Save, Only Thrusk (No emerald)
Rusk: Hidden room in the Guild
Yeet: Unlock the hidden island
Gorg: Hidden Companion
Tree: Hidden Shop item in the world
Quill: Hidden Item In the world
Ranger: Hidden interaction
Baeron: Hidden Item
Venge: Hidden Character (This is the new companion in the patch)
Moonie: Hidden Armor (If Bard, Cleric, or Paladin)

We thank you for your patience and apologize for the mishap.

If you get a pickaxe and a rope from the general store in the first town then travel all the way around the back outter rim of the city (headed left from the main gate) til you get stuck against the building on the other side, pickaxe the rock and you'll get "Toilet paper" somewhere over there which can be used to clean the cursed "stick" item (there is a cauldron at the end of the Void level in a later act of the game) that will give you bonus EXP, a good bunch of stats and multiple strikes in one.

Have fun, and happy anniversary!

Puds

notes.title: The patch has been reverted (with some potential caveats)
notes.content:
The game has been reverted. If you patched the game already, we apologize for the inconvenience but your save files (As well as mine) are gone. If you didn't patch and they're still gone, again - apologies for the inconvenience. We will be attempting to re-patch on the 2nd or 3rd once we've got the kinks worked out. While I realize it's little to absolutely no consolation - The new companion requires a game restart with a specific name.

The name you would use as the main character to unlock this new companion is, "Venge"
As an apology I will be giving out the specialty names in the discussion forums as well as a couple of hidden game tidbits to help you along your way. Expect this when the patch drops again.

We are so sorry for the loss of save data. As soon as it was brought to my attention I did my best to get on here and let you all know. (Now I -also- have to restart.)

Please bear with us as we get this sorted. In the meantime the game is back to its former build.

Puds

notes.title: Happy Anniversary!
notes.content:
We couldn't have done this without those of you reading this right now.

It's been one year since the official release of The Tale of Galariel. It came at the heels of so many other great titles launching into steam (Some of which we collectively played at the time ourselves). The relief we felt when we finally launched a finished game gave us all such a wonderful sense of accomplishment and we all could breath easy for a bit...

Until we decided to do it again.

After four-ish years of a single dev into double devs, into more and more people joining in to help make this game come alive it became apparent that we wanted to keep going. Now sporting twice the size we did on the release of Galariel we continue to try to find new talent to add to our team and make amazing games! Our goal is to never need a publishing company to fund us as long as we exist; and to continue to produce higher and higher quality content.

Everyone in our team volunteers their time to be here and make this happen using everything in their arsenal of skills that they can to cover every edge of the projects we're working on. Now with "G2" on the horizon I'm excited to say that We Didn't Mean 2 be here. But we are. It's going to be a big change. It's going to take a lot of time and people-hours to make what we want a reality.

At the end of this blood soaked tale of rainbows and sprinkles we wanted to, at some point, try our hand at this, "business stuff". Our goal as a development team moving forward from our current structure is to become a proper LLC. We see it, we want it and we're going to go for it. We want to have an office for ourselves to work out of. We want to be a proper game developer. That line of thinking - These goals - have spawned from this game's launch.

We hope we can continue to make you proud. We hope that you find comfort and enjoyment in our games. We are grateful for every breath and every second that our community has given to us.

With much love and appreciation,

We are WDM2

notes.title: (Major update announcement!) Oh lord it comin'
notes.content:
You've had the game for a few months now and while we're certain the replay value can speak for itself - We don't want to leave things as stale as Ty's underpants. This my friends is a call to arms! Grab your gear, grab your main crew and get ready to run a blade through the belly of some beasts!

[b]This major update will include:[/b]

[list]
[*] New area(s) to explore
[*] New item(s) to access
[*] New enemies to face
[*] A new music track for the new area(s)
[*] Freshly remastered music tracks
[*] New endings to experience
[*] New file size that thankfully won't make your storage drive scream for help*
[*] Smart Phone Fast Charging Capabilities**
[/list]

[b]Some questions you might have with answers included:[/b]

[u]"Hey WDM2, didn't you mention fishing stuff?"[/u]

Yes, we did! It's currently part of the game! Thank you for asking again as you'll be happy to know that we did a light addition to that as well! There's another new spot available!

[u]"What about romances in game?!"[/u]

We tried! You have one option. It was romances or loyalty missions and since we had a romance scripted already it wasn't really something we wanted to not only write out of the script but also re-code entirely. Again, we did try. Such are the limitations of the engine we were working with.

[u]"Do you guys have a Youtube or a Twitch or something?"[/u]

As a matter of fact, we do! All of us are affiliates on twitch - and we are making a WDM2 team! You will be able to find those links in the game discussion hub soon!


[u]"Are you guys going to make any more major content updates after this?"[/u]

Nope! This is it. Hotfixes and dialog patches when we find them (and a FREE DLC or two) but otherwise this is the finale~

[u]"Are you guys going to make another game then?"[/u]

([i]pssst[/i]) Come closer....

Yes.
A second game is currently in production! We wanted to be sure to have this one done properly before fully moving on and committing our limited resources to it. It is currently in the script writing/story-boarding point.

[u]"Whens the new game coming out?"[/u]

Good question! The first one took three years; So hopefully in a couple years time we can give you an estimate but for now - That is a really, really good question. It'll happen though!

[u]"What about console ports?"[/u]

This is a complicated question. We've been looking into it on the side but the amount of resources it would require currently outweighs the potential benefits. We are a small group of dedicated people doing our best with what we have available. We want to - But we lack in areas that would make it reasonable at this moment in time. Some consoles also don't accept the type of code we use so that would require us to make an entire second version of the game on a different engine.

[u]"Well what if I wanted to toss some funding at you in the hopes we could see that in the future?"[/u]

While anything donated or purchased is always appreciated and goes toward our development efforts - We can't make any full guarantees about this. If there's enough support behind it to reasonably consider doing so we can talk about it more. For now, we've shelved the idea in an effort to focus on the next game.

--------------------
As always, thank you for your support and thank you for playing the game! We hope to have good news for you in the future!

*Storage drives in the red currently not-withstanding
**Does not actually have anything to do with anything

notes.title: Let's get the broth to a simmer
notes.content:
What better way to celebrate the consumption of food items then with a bit of goblin stew. The irony is not lost on me - Consuming something filled with so much greed and gluttony is likely to make ones stomach turn. They do simmer well, though. Was it necessary to hunt down and capture some goblins for this feast? Absolutely not. I can't in good faith, however, allow Thrusk's forces to stay at maximum strength all the time now can I? That would go against the fine print in the documents he signed... I digress. We're here to discuss food, not so much where it came from.

Though if you've come to make a deal with me I have a most favorable opportunity for you. How about you give me a small amount of your nations currency and in exchange I give you something to enjoy for hours upon hours?

No? Well, alright. Unless.... How about even less of your nations currency for this wonderful little item? I'll knock 30% off of what I was originally going to ask of you and this little world in a bubble can be all yours.

Splendid. 

Just. Sign. Here. _______________________

And initial here...

And date there...

[b][i]Perfect.[/i][/b]

I'll see you inside.

notes.title: Good evening, intrepid antagonist
notes.content:
It's that spooky time of year when all of the monsters run free and create chaos, not unlike yourself. In an effort to support your bloodletting, I, your local merchant am offering you a discount on some goods you may find most titillating... A new sword perhaps? Maybe some caustic liquids?

What about an entire world that you can run around freely in and do as you wish?

A little pocket dimension - just for you! My best customers always get the best items.
I'll even throw in a discount, but be sure to keep this between you and I. I wouldn't want anyone else realizing the deal you're getting and demanding the same. So how about it?

30% off through the week of all hallows eve! Grab yourself a copy and get to chopping my dear friend.

notes.title: Mild fishing patch
notes.content: Hello there intrepid adventurer! I appear to have lost a few recipe cards while I was out ice fishing. If you wouldn't mind finding them for me, you are welcome to keep them! I just don't want them to go to waste. I had to run back to my cabin due to the cold to get my coat and I slipped on the ice, dropping three of them in the process. Do be cautious though; They may be in the possession of some nasty critters!
